cards.card_text: They ask the Lord to show them which of the two He has chosen for the ministry and apostleship that Judas abandoned.
cards.verse_text: Show us which of these two You have chosen to take up this ministry and apostleship, which Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place.”
cards.snippet: …of these two You have chosen to take up this ministry and apostleship, which Judas abandoned to go to his rightful place.”

cards.card_text: Then Paul gives Him His full name: 'Jesus Christ our Lord.' Through Him, Paul says, we received grace and apostleship.
cards.verse_text: Through Him and on behalf of His name, we received grace and apostleship to call all those among the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith.

cards.card_text: Peter's apostleship is to the circumcised, and Paul's is to the Gentiles.
cards.verse_text: For the One who was at work in Peter’s apostleship to the circumcised was also at work in my apostleship to the Gentiles.
